fair_value_reason: P/E only (100%), on verified inputs. FY27 EPS $12.47 = midpoint of consensus $12.97 (StockAnalysis/S&P Global, verified) and $11.97 (underlying FY26 $8.79 + 1,570 x 16.1% x (1 - 0.246) / 60.0M). FY28 = 12.47 x 1.13 = $14.09 (+13%, the median of the five agents' FY28 growth rates; no 2028 backlog outside Amazon). Horizon NTM EPS = 0.25 x 12.47 + 0.75 x 14.09 = $13.68. Multiple 17.33x = 0.5 x 14.06 (LII/AOS/CARR median) + 0.5 x 20.60 (CMI/CAT mean), each peer forward P/E re-derived by the citation gate as Oct 9 close / NTM consensus EPS (0.227 x FY2026 + 0.773 x FY2027): LII 356.44 / 25.39 = 14.04x, AOS 56.38 / 4.01 = 14.06x, CARR 55.56 / 3.20 = 17.34x, CMI 523.39 / 33.64 = 15.56x, CAT 800.47 / 31.23 = 25.63x (the vendor ratios 14.43/14.47/18.19/15.94/27.78 gave 18.17x). Value 13.68 x 17.33 = $237.1, rounded to $237 (basis: estimate). Sensitivity: no haircut gives $246.7; full haircut gives $227.7; +/-1x multiple is +/-$13.7. Cross-checks, not weighted: own-history 19.475x median gives $266.5 (set in a lower-rate regime); DCF $134-139 (bear-tail anchor); EV/EBITDA legs need a consistent EBITDA basis (see disagreements). Shares 60.0M = 59,006,361 outstanding at 7/31/26 (10-Q cover) + 0.813M award dilution (Q2 diluted 59,635,447 less basic 58,822,634) + 0.033M treasury-method warrant shares (307,954 x (1 - 200.9266/224.94)) = 59.85M today, ~60.0M at the horizon. Net debt $1,064.4M = 48.318 + 32.052 + 1,248.958 - 264.921 at 6/30/26 (10-Q and Q2 release). It is not used by the P/E leg; it is used only in the EV/EBITDA basis restatements.
supervisor_summary: All five round-2 forecasts now agree, correctly, that the second hyperscaler signed on June 24, 2026 (June 2 was the first) and is Amazon. I confirmed that with the Q2 release and the Global Purchase Agreement recited in the Amazon Transaction Agreement; the explicit naming exists only in press. I set the DCF weight to zero because at verified inputs it values GNRC below any multiple it or its peers have traded at, and I haircut FY27 EPS by about 4% to $12.47 because consensus needs incremental margins above what C&I has shown ex refund. I also found that agents 2 and 5 inflate their EV/EBITDA legs by mixing EBITDA bases. The citation gate then re-derived the peer multiples from Oct 9 closes, NTM consensus and filings (target multiple 18.17x to 17.33x), giving a $237 fair value, 6% below the $252.9 agent mean; with low confidence the ladder stays the agents' mean (P(>= $225) 0.57), with a $155 thesis break.
key_drivers: Data-center conversion: $1.6B backlog with $1.35B scheduled for 2027 and nothing for 2028 (Q2 call), plus Amazon, the June 24 second hyperscaler, with $2.4B of expected 2027-28 deliveries and a firm minimum of redacted size (8-K, Ex. 10.1). Capacity is to triple from the $1.25B year-end-2026 target within ~12 months.

Earnings quality: FY26 consensus $9.69 includes ~$0.90 of one-off tariff refunds. FY27 consensus $12.97 needs a ~21% incremental margin on +$1.57B of revenue, against a verified 16.1% ex-refund C&I incremental in H1 2026. I haircut FY27 to $12.47.

Segment mix sets the multiple: residential was 53% of Q2 sales (25.4% ex-refund H1 EBITDA margin) and C&I 12.8% ex refund. Reconciled multiple 17.33x vs a 23.40x core peer median (NTM consensus basis), and 18.40x NTM consensus today (224.94 / 12.22).
Rates: 10-yr 5.24% and beta 1.92 give a DCF of only $134-139 (below any multiple GNRC has traded at since 2021). It belongs in the bear tail, not the centre.
Amazon warrant: 1,693,745 shares at $200.9266 (307,954 vested), vesting against up to $8B of payments by 2033. It is a price concession whose revenue accounting is not yet shown in a filing.
